author: The Q
description:
At CES 2026, Yarbo introduced the M-Series, a more compact and practical evolution of its modular yard robot system.

If you’ve seen our review of Yarbo’s larger model last year, this video continues that story.
The M-Series keeps the same modular idea, but sizes it for normal yards and regular weekly use.

In this video, I take a hands-on look at:
-Why the M-Series exists
-How the core + modular approach works in practice
-What feels different compared to the larger Yarbo we tested previously
-And who this system actually makes sense for

Learn more about the Yarbo M-Series:
https://go.yarbo.com/xXuWd
title: Yarbo at CES 2026: A Modular Yard Robot Built for Real Homes
